data.booking_notes:
Hi there, 

We’re so looking forward to welcoming you to the Sunset Sound Experience tomorrow — Thursday, July 24 at 7 PM — at @cascadetrails in Joshua Tree.

You’re welcome to arrive a little early to get settled, sign waivers, and take care of any remaining payment if needed.

This special evening is led by @luna, a classically trained vocal artist and mystical sound healer, and includes:

SUNSET EXPERIENCE: 
7PM – Intro to the Sanctuary and the wild horses
 7:20PM – Sip on herbal tea + elixirs to ground your mind 
7:30-8:30 PM Sunset Sound Bath under the open desert sky

What to bring:
• Yoga mat
• Blanket
• Water bottle


✨ Carrots for the horses are always appreciated — feel free to bring some, or purchase a bundle on site.

Cost: $50 (A portion of the proceeds will be donated to @cascadetrails)
What’s included: Interactive horse experience, tea elixirs, and sound bath
Not included: Yoga mat, blanket, water

We can’t wait to share this magical desert evening with you. See you on the mat. 🤍

Warmly,
Team Cascade Trails
